**General**
- Request accessibility permission on macOS so 3d mode mouselook works correctly (thanks @Pedro-Beirao)
- Fixed sizing of columns on keyboard shortcuts preferences page in linux/gtk
- Fixed build under linux aarch64 (thanks @Blzut3)

**Game Formats & Features**
- Added EDGE-Classic support (thanks @dashodanger)
- Various improvements to jaguar sprite support including conversion (thanks @viciious)
- Updated Eternity UDMF configurations (thanks @Altazimuth)
- Updated ZDoom language configurations (thanks @Blue-Shadow)
- Updated SRB2 lua language configuration (thanks @JadenArcm)

**Scripting**
- Lua scripts should no longer be able to crash SLADE as easily

**Resource Editor**
- Entry editor panels are now loaded on-demand, which greatly speeds up opening archives
- Enabled more actions when only directories are selected
- Fixed issues with 'Open Map in DB2' feature
  - Updated map entries were being inserted at the wrong position
  - The last map entry wasn't being unlocked after DB2 was closed
- Fixed flickering when switching between different entries of the same type on certain systems
- Fixed gfx offset drag preview not snapping to pixels

**Text Editor**
- Support for font ligatures in Windows (if the font being used has them)
- Common Find+Replace settings are now remembered between sessions
- Added support for multiple selection and cursors
  - `Ctrl`+`Click` - Add a new cursor
  - `Alt`+`Shift`+`Up/Down` - Copy the current selection and cursor up/down a line (not the text itself, just the selection)
  - `Ctrl`+`D` - Select the next occurrence of the current selection (based on the current find+replace settings), or select the current word if there isn't a selection
  - `Ctrl`+`Shift`+`D` - Select all occurrences of the current selection
- Fixed brace match highlighting causing stuttering in Windows

**Map Editor**
- Moving a sector now also moves things within it (thanks @thezerobit)
- Added keybinds to rotate things in 2d mode (`<` and `>` by default) (thanks @thezerobit)
- Switching from sectors to things mode will select any things within the previously selected sectors (thanks @thezerobit)
- Fixed TranslucentLine special handling in UDMF maps, which was erroneously setting `alpha` and `renderstyle` properties on lines
- Fixed issue with copy/paste thing properties and undo (thanks @thezerobit)
- Fixed being able to mirror horizontally/vertically during object edit which could cause issues (thanks @thezerobit)
- Fixed Mirror X/Y checkboxes remaining ticked (but not working) between different object edit operations (thanks @thezerobit)
- Fixed edit object thing scaling origin to match lines/vertices (from center) (thanks @thezerobit)
